distance_au.sort: from the closest to the Sun to the farthest

rows.label: Earth
rows.description: third planet from the Sun in the Solar System
rows.hook: is the only known planet with life and liquid water oceans on its surface

rows.label: Jupiter
rows.description: fifth planet in the Solar System and largest among all; gaseous giant mainly composed of hydrogen and helium
rows.hook: is the largest planet in the solar system and hosts a giant storm bigger than the earth

rows.label: Venus
rows.description: second planet from the Solar System, tellurian and very similar to Earth
rows.hook: is the hottest planet due to a runaway greenhouse effect trapping heat under thick clouds

rows.label: Saturn
rows.description: sixth planet in the Solar System, with a ring system mainly composed of ice particles
rows.hook: is famous for its bright rings made of ice and rock

rows.label: Mars
rows.description: fourth planet from the Solar System, tellurian and orange-red due to iron oxide
rows.hook: gets its reddish color from rusted iron in its soil

rows.label: Mercury
rows.description: first planet from the Solar System and smallest among all, tellurian and with extreme temperatures
rows.hook: is the smallest planet and swings between the most extreme day and night temperatures

rows.label: Neptune
rows.description: eighth and farthest planet from the Sun in the Solar System, mainly composed of ice and rock
rows.hook: is the windiest planet, with the fastest recorded winds in the solar system

rows.label: Uranus
rows.description: seventh planet in the Solar System, mainly composed of hydrogen and helium
rows.hook: spins on its side, rotating almost perpendicular to its orbit around the sun
